items.title_zh: 印度影响者分享在加拿大退回亚马逊包裹的“挣扎”，接受“奴隶心态”教育
items.title_en: Indian Influencer Shares 'Struggles' of Returning Amazon Package In Canada, Gets Schooled for 'Slave Mindse
items.summary_zh: 印度裔女性嘲笑加拿大亚马逊要求顾客自行处理退货，并因不敏感而受到指责。
items.summary_en: Indian-origin woman mocks Amazon Canada for asking customers to handle the returns by themselves, gets trolled for insensitive take.

items.title_zh: 比哈尔邦老师在检查 PPU 考试答卷时在 Instagram 上疯传，视频疯传
items.title_en: Bihar Teacher Makes Instagram Reels While Checking PPU Exam Answer Sheets, Videos Go Viral
items.summary_zh: 这些视频讲述了比哈尔邦的一名老师在制作 Instagram Reels 的同时，在没有仔细阅读 PPU 考试答卷的情况下对答卷进行标记的情况。
items.summary_en: The videos feature a teacher in Bihar making Instagram Reels while marking PPU exam answer sheets without reading them carefully.

items.title_zh: 阿格拉学校校长因老师迟到而殴打老师，视频疯传
items.title_en: Agra School Principal Beats Teacher For Being Late, Video Goes Viral
items.summary_zh: 阿格拉学校校长和老师迟到后互相攻击，视频疯传。
items.summary_en: Agra school principal and teacher attack each other after the latter got late, video goes viral.
